research_insights.label: Business model
research_insights.value: Subscription membership combines confidential peer groups with one-to-one coaching, creating recurring executive relationships rather than relying on stand-alone events.

research_insights.label: Scale
research_insights.value: The announcement reported more than 27,000 members across 26 countries at the time of the transaction.

research_insights.label: Ownership signal
research_insights.value: Management invested alongside Gridiron, aligning the operating team with the next phase of the platform's growth.

research_insights.label: Sponsor thesis
research_insights.value: Gridiron linked the opportunity to its experience in professional training and human-capital management businesses.

deals.title: CEB acquires Evanta from Leeds Equity Partners
deals.investment_thesis: CEB added a C-suite peer-engagement and leadership-events platform that expanded its professional-development reach and created sponsorship and content-licensing opportunities.

provider_roles.role: financial adviser to CEB in connection with the Evanta acquisition

research_insights.label: Revenue model
research_insights.value: Evanta primarily generated revenue from event sponsorship fees, with seasonality concentrated in the second and fourth quarters.

research_insights.label: Strategic fit
research_insights.value: CEB said the acquisition would expand its events and professional-development businesses and increase its addressable market through sponsorship and content licensing.

research_insights.label: Financing
research_insights.value: CEB increased its term loan facility by $150 million and its revolving facility by $100 million to help fund the acquisition.

research_insights.label: Purchase accounting
research_insights.value: CEB reported $269.2 million of consideration net of acquired cash and recorded $237.2 million of goodwill.

deals.title: Gartner acquires CEB
deals.investment_thesis: The combination brought together subscription research, best-practice advisory, enterprise executive communities and an events portfolio that included Evanta.

provider_roles.role: financial adviser and fairness-opinion provider to CEB

research_insights.label: Transaction structure
research_insights.value: Gartner agreed to pay CEB shareholders cash plus Gartner shares in a transaction valued at approximately $2.6 billion.

research_insights.label: Community adjacency
research_insights.value: CEB combined membership-based research and decision support with executive briefings, destination events and the Evanta C-suite community business.

research_insights.label: Scale strategy
research_insights.value: Gartner positioned the combination as a way to serve major enterprise functions with a broader research and advisory platform.

research_insights.label: Process evidence
research_insights.value: The joint proxy documents the negotiation process and identifies Centerview for CEB and Goldman Sachs and Evercore for Gartner.
